candidates.title: NISAR: Tracking Earth’s Changes From Space (Mission Overview)
candidates.description: NASA and ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation) have teamed up to create a powerful new space mission that will track our changing Earth in fine detail. The satellite, called NISAR, will use an advanced radar system to deepen our understanding of deforestation, shrinking glaciers and sea ice loss
